resources.string: No root. That\'s fine: turn on the accessibility helper below and the app will tap \"Power off\" for you.
You get a notification 60 seconds before the phone turns off, and you can cancel it there.
Needs root. Experimental. Sets the phone\'s hardware alarm (RTC) when this app powers it off. Many phones ignore it, so try the test below first.
Allow exact alarms so the schedule fires on time.
Powers the phone off now and asks it to turn back on in 3 minutes. If it doesn\'t come back, your phone doesn\'t support scheduled power on (press the power button to start it).
The phone will shut down immediately. Save anything you\'re working on.
Tap Cancel to keep the phone on.
The phone will turn back on at %1$s.
Turn on the Power Scheduler accessibility helper, or grant root. Tap for details.

Opens the power menu and taps \"Power off\" for you. Works on most phones, but not every brand\'s power menu. If your phone asks for your PIN to power off, turn that setting off. Use the test button to check.
Android 13+: if the switch is greyed out, go to Settings → Apps → Power Scheduler → ⋮ → \"Allow restricted settings\", then try again.
Lets Power Scheduler open the power menu and tap \"Power off\" at the times you schedule. It doesn\'t read or collect anything else.
